verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves the prior major finding. The verdict state now records whether a head-moving timeline row occurs after the newest review:pass grant independently of the commit's self-reported author/committer timestamp, and every preserve route checks that combined tree-integrity predicate before re-arming. The end-to-end tests exercise the real timeline parser with both a backdated post-grant commit and an undated post-grant commit, and also pin the legitimate re-grant case where the commit precedes the newest grant. No new correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue is evident in the diff.
